label: For "Network Change Risk Scoring": Score each planned network change for the probability that it causes a customer-impacting incident, so reviewers focus approval time on risky changes and safe ones flow quickly. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Labelling by time overlap.
